rows.text: The Élysée archive publishes an address of François Mitterrand dated 3 January 1990, headed as given by the President of the Republic at the diplomatic corps' New Year wishes; he thanks the Nuncio for the wishes expressed 'à l'intention de mon pays et de moi-même'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff).
